name: Sella
personality: Sharp, transactional, quick-witted. Everything has a price. Not cruel — just done with places that die. Respects competence.
drives: Turn a profit and leave before the light dies
Map the ridge path she found, and sell it to the right buyer
backstory: Drifts between failing towns trading what she scavenges. She found a partial way up the ridge and survived it — the only living soul who has. She won't share it cheaply, and won't die for this town.
speech_style: Fast, transactional, faintly amused. Deals in offers and counteroffers. Warms only to people who don't waste her time.
knowledge: A partial safe path exists up the ridge
The dark on the ridge is cold in a way that isn't natural
Everyone in town wants something they won't say out loud
secrets: Sella turned back on the ridge because she heard something calling her by a dead friend's name
She is more afraid of the ridge than she will ever let a buyer see
